summary: Revised v2 implementation plan incorporating the Pattern Lab consumption layer (predict_next_beat, odd_one_out, sort_group, transfer_slot on held-out concepts, cue_transfer across paired scenarios), errorless-to-fade scaffolding ladder (L1-L3 choices, S3-S0 scaffolds), separate recall vs. pattern acquisition measurement, 24-concept seed graph with 6 held-out transfer items and varied exemplars, child vs. caregiver interactive views, per-child consent and append-only attempt records with offline queue sync, privacy-enhanced YouTube embeds, and Lumo caregiver-only AI boundary.
